cover letter
Must possess a valid license to drive in the state of California and participate in the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) pull notice program.
Demonstrated skill and experience in interior and exterior painting and drywall repair.

Under the general supervision of the Trades and Projects Coordinator, the Senior Building Maintenance Worker-Warehouse, will perform various routine semi-skilled and skilled building maintenance tasks in residence halls, dining halls, apartment complexes, administrative offices, and other related facilities. The incumbent will be responsible for all shipping and receiving processed at the Facilities off-campus warehouse, maintain warehouse inventory and transport warehouse items to and from the warehouse and various campus/off-campus locations. The incumbent will also assist the Skilled Crafts Workers in performing complex repairs and remodeling projects.
The Senior Building Maintenance Worker - Warehouse must interact effectively on a daily basis with other Facilities staff, Dining staff, student staff, and residential customers.
Selected candidate will be required to pass a pre-employment criminal history background check.
Selected candidate must pass the employment misconduct disclosure process.
Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.

Basic knowledge of and demonstrated skill in routine plumbing, electrical, and carpentry repair and troubleshooting.
Ability to perform work overhead and to perform repetitive tasks.
Knowledge of basic electrical theory and safe practices for performing electrical repairs.
The ability to work from a stepladders and extension ladders.
Basic knowledge of and demonstrated skill in routine plumbing, electrical, and carpentry repair and troubleshooting.
The ability to safely move 50 lbs. with or without accommodations.
Demonstrated skill in the safe use of various hand and power tools used in building maintenance, including drills, saws, sewer rodders, and power sanders.
Ability to perform heavy manual tasks including the ability to move up to 70 pounds; moving materials such as furniture, cartons, equipment, supplies, etc., with or without accommodation.
Knowledge of warehouse and delivery operations, including proper recording of receipts and issuance of materials/supplies in a large institutional environment.
Ability to work safely in areas where hazardous materials are present or stored.

Demonstrated ability to work under minimal supervision and to follow written and oral instructions. The ability to read University correspondence, training materials, policies and procedures with comprehension sufficient to act appropriately based on the written materials.

Ability to exercise good judgment to ensure that the lifting and movement of material is undertaken safely at all times, requesting assistance from coworkers and/or using moving equipment to handle loads that are too heavy or cumbersome for a single person to move unaided.

Computer skills sufficient to use an on-line computerized maintenance management system and utilize that system to receive and update the status of work orders. Knowledge of personal computer productivity tools, including word processing software, e-mail, and Internet browser applications. Writing skills sufficient to draft work correspondence and prepare written instructions to staff and student workers.
Interpersonal and communication skills necessary to work effectively and cooperatively with Housing residents, student employees, Housing staff, campus craft workers, and faculty.
The ability to perform basic arithmetic calculations necessary for maintenance tasks, record keeping, and inventory maintenance.
Ability to instruct student maintenance assistants in the performance of basic repair and maintenance tasks (such as lamp changing and interior touch-up painting) and to direct their work.
Ability to work on multiple tasks, under pressure of deadlines.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team; to appropriately prioritize work; and to communicate progress to supervisor on assigned projects.
Ability to work cooperatively with individuals from diverse, cultural, ethnic and socio economic backgrounds.
